messages:
devon: Quick sync — embeddings endpoint launch decisions needed: batching limits, default dims, model choices, response format/export options, and minimal launch criteria. Who can weigh in? cc @anya @matt @sophia

anya: from product POV: must support a high-quality default (1536) and a cost tier (512). Launch must include: 1) server-side auto-splitting for >max_items, 2) per-input length metadata, 3) export options for bulk customers (ndjson/npz). We need an explicit `dimension` in responses for compatibility.

matt: engineering constraints — GPU memory and latency drive sensible defaults. Back-of-envelope: float16 1536 dims ~= 3KB per vector. With 32GB GPU, safe concurrent batch tokens -> cap default batch_items=1024. Also propose `auto_split=true` server-side which returns multiple sub-responses when request exceeds limits. Practical API example: 

```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-1536",
  "inputs": ["..."],
  "response_format": "jsonl",
  "auto_split": true
}
```

matt: Implementation note: enforce a hard max of 2048 items per incoming request and do server-side slicing; clients should receive `split_count` + `split_index` metadata per chunk.

sophia: model selection recs: prioritize `rwd-embed-1536` for semantic fidelity, `rwd-embed-512` for cost-sensitive workloads. Also prepare quantized variants: `rwd-embed-1536-q8` (likely ~+2x throughput, small quality delta). I'll run evals against our reference KB and supply delta matrix by EOD.

lia: customer asks: many customers need stable ID mapping (input -> embedding). Please echo back `input_id` for each vector and include `lengths` so they can realign after splits. For bulk export, `ndjson` with one JSON object per input is preferred.

prashant: ops concerns: observability & debugging: add `x-emb-split-id` header for each split and log `batch_items`, `model`, `quantized` flags. Rate limits: recommend per-item quotas (items/sec) rather than per-request to avoid accidental large-batch abuse.

devon: Draft decision checklist: - default dims: 1536 (default) and 512 (cost tier) - default per-request cap: 1024 items; hard reject >2048 items - server-side `auto_split` = true with `split_count`/`split_index` - response includes `embedding` (array of floats), `dimension`, `input_id`, `lengths` and optional `embedding_metadata` map - supported `response_format`: `json`, `jsonl`, `npz` (beta) - SDKs must expose auto-splitting client-side as opt-in. Launch blocked until SDK rollout + basic evals.

anya: SLOs / launch criteria suggestion: perf targets per-dim tier: p50 < 300ms for 512-d on Dedicated, p50 < 700ms for 1536-d on Dedicated. Also require functional compatibility with top 3 pilot customers and successful ndjson export test.

matt: I'll add `max_batch_items` param and server-side splitter. Also adding prefix/KV cache note: prefix caching only works for identical strings; dedupe on input hash first.

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline update: feature branch "embeddings-splitter" -> canary in staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC, rollback window 30m.

devon: Action items captured: @sophia -> eval delta for q8 and rwd-embed-512 vs 1536; @matt -> API + SDK + split implementation; @lia -> prepare customer comms & ndjson template; @prashant -> logging/headers + rate-limit changes. I'll update the spec doc with these decisions and put the launch milestone on the roadmap. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
